about_short_description.short_description: TABsense is an information technology company that develops Agentic AI PoS Solutions for the F&B sector.

product.name: TABsense Agentic AI POS
product.description: A cloud-based point-of-sale platform for restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and barbershops, combining sales, ordering, inventory, staff, customer, and business-management functions.

product.name: TABsense Assistant
product.description: An AI business insights assistant that answers questions about revenue, best-selling items, menu performance, and related business data through WhatsApp.

product.name: AI Reviews Agent
product.description: An AI-powered reviews analytics service that consolidates customer feedback across branches and identifies strengths, problems, and improvement opportunities.

product.name: MenuIQ Agent
product.description: An AI menu-pricing analysis agent that compares menu prices with those of more than 20 local competitors to support item-level pricing decisions.

product.name: AI Voice Agent
product.description: An always-on voice ordering agent that automatically accepts customer orders through call centers, kiosks, websites, or mobile applications.

product.name: AI Recommendations
product.description: An AI-driven product recommendation feature that suggests menu items based on individual customer behavior and preferences.
